reviews.text: Great, prompt service. Tells you everything you need to know. Very experienced. Repair came out as good as could have been!
reviews.author: Elliott

reviews.text: If you are looking for honest and reliable, you have found the right people! I thought my pump was out and it would be expensive to replace. Turns out the pump was not the problem. The fix was quick, easy and not expensive. They could have easily charged me to replace the pump, but thankfully they have integrity. When I have any problems in the future, this is who I will call.
reviews.author: Dana Feddersen

reviews.text: Mike and the gang just completely remodeled my 70's era gunnite pool and did a spectacular job.  The guys really got after it while they were here and completed their work as-promised, as-quoted, and on time.  Additionally, they were very respectful of our time and property and did a really thorough clean-up of the backyard when they were done.  I am so pleased that I intend to sign a contract for maintenance now that the remodel is done.  Very happy!
reviews.author: Tim Wygant

reviews.text: These guys are the best, they replastered our pool and do all the maintenance on it.  It now has that beautiful sparkly diamond look found only with white plaster and crystal clear water.  So glad we found these Mr. Pool Repair!
reviews.author: Marilyn Pohly

reviews.text: Their pool school really helped my wife and I get started with our first pool.  The staff is very friendly and will recommend multiple solutions to your pool issues, then talk you through your options.
reviews.author: Michael Christoffel

reviews.text: Their Pool School was so helpful!! The store staff is super friendly and helpful. I really wish someone had told me about Mr. Pool months ago!
reviews.author: J Curtis
